column3: It walks (os.walk, node_modules and dist pruned) the style-bearing files (.css, .njk, .html, fonts*.json) under those Core folders and copies them, with the two sign-in theme files in harness/ by name, into a temporary folder that every plant is written into; the real-tree cases run the check itself over OspreyFlow_Core, which reads the same folders (packages/themes is absent today); nothing real is written.
